about: Halton Hills is a town in Halton Region, at the Niagara Escarpment northwest of Toronto. Georgetown is the main urban centre; Acton, Glen Williams, and Limehouse sit among remaining farms and the Credit River valley. GO Transit and Highway 401/7 commuting mix with mill-town history and conservation lands. About 63,000 people live in Halton Hills.
